newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African cop kills two to avenge brother's murder.
newsitem.headline: S.African cop kills two to avenge brother's murder.

text.p: A South African policeman shot dead a mother and her teenage son who was on trial for the murder of the policeman's brother, a police spokesman said on Monday.
The unidentified policeman and the 18-year-old were arguing outside the Pietermaritzburg High Court when the policeman fired shots at the youth and his mother, the spokesman told Reuters.

"The mother was killed instantly and her son died while he was receiving medical treatment at the scene," he said. The policeman was arrested and it was unclear whether he was on duty at the time, the spokesman added.
